structured.answer: If the money stays in the עו"ש it slowly loses value, because most banks pay no interest on it. Their example says 10,000 ₪ is worth only 8,203 ₪ in today's money after 10 years. I didn't work out what that means for our own amount, so I'll ask my son or the bank before moving anything.
